question: Compare Nike's and PepsiCo's gross margin in their FY2022 filings.
answer: In fiscal 2022, Nike reported a gross margin of 46% [Nike FY23 p.35], while PepsiCo recorded a gross margin of 53.03% [PepsiCo FY22 p.62].
